text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle involves more than just eating well. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the fuel it needs. Regular exercise, even a daily thirty-minute walk, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is getting enough quality sleep, as your body repairs itself during those hours. Don't forget your mental health, either; taking time to relax, practice mindfulness, or talk to friends can reduce stress. Finally, strive for a work-life balance by setting boundaries between your job and personal time. Prioritizing these habits will help you feel more energetic and content every day.
